key.name: server-url
key.description: Base URL of the server; "?ts=<timestamp of today's local midnight>" is appended.

key.name: background
key.summary: How to fill the screen around the image

key.name: background-color
key.summary: Color around the image when background is "color"

key.name: check-interval
key.summary: Minutes between checks of the server
key.description: The server may have several images for the same day; the wallpaper changes only when the image is different.

key.name: panel-indicator
key.description: An icon in the top bar with the data of the image and a notification when the image changes.

key.name: language
key.description: Language code asked to the server (e.g. "es"). Empty: the language of the system.

key.name: show-label
key.description: The server adds a label with the reason, title, author and year.

key.name: show-date
key.description: "YYYY-MM-DD" chosen with "Use as wallpaper"; the next automatic check returns to today. Empty: today.

key.name: refresh-request
key.summary: Changed by the preferences window to download the image again

key.name: image-hash
key.summary: SHA-1 of the current original image
key.description: The server is checked every 30 minutes; the wallpaper changes only when the image is different.

key.name: current-file
key.summary: Path of the current composed wallpaper

key.name: title
key.summary: Title (and date) of the current image

key.name: reason
key.summary: Why the current image is shown that day

key.name: status
key.summary: Result of the last check of the server
